name: Finger Gun, Bigger
body:
School evocation; Level magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you; see text
Duration 10 minutes; see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions similarly to the finger gun cantrip, with the exception that each shot deals 1d6 plus your casting modifier points of force damage.
